turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay.
Funny? Which part, the zero or the way my son found out about it?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
My son wrote that essay. What do you have on paper?
I'm sorry? Owen's essay, Hale. What do you have?
